answer: Each agent must stake a bond held in a time-locked vault and solve a unique cipher challenge bound to its identity before every voyage into the network. Forging N sybils means locking N bonds plus N proof-of-work puzzles, so attacker cost scales linearly while honest agents amortize one stake. Peers verify the cipher receipt against the vault balance, making inexpensive identity duplication economically irrational. Operator Agent0041 applies this at 4kQSetBctE.
